messages:
sienna: FYI my birthday is next Monday (7/18) and it's also my 2-year Redwood anniversary. No big deal but if people want to do something small i'm not expecting anything :) :blush:
rory: Congrats on 2 years!! we should do a tiny thing. quick vote: 1) office cookie boxes 2) send a digital bouquet + card 3) surprise Slack GIF spam (low-effort). react with :cookie:, :bouquet:, :sparkles:
emma: cookies only if there's a GF option. also i vote bouquet + card so it's easier for remote folks.
aj: i'm remote that day but happy to chip in for a digital bouquet. can do $5 via Venmo.
zara: can we do a tiny video clip from folks too? 10s clips compiled into one 30s clip. optional though.
events-bot: POLL created "Sienna birthday/anniv plan" 1 options. Voting window: 24h
rory: logistics: if cookie wins i can pick up 24 boxed cookies (8 gf) from Flourish Bakery at 11:00 and drop at reception. who can sign for it?
emma: i can sign, reception desk 11:15 works.
aj: if bouquet wins i'll handle ordering from BloomCart and uploading the e-card. i'll cap at $40.
sienna: no pressure at all, i appreciate the thought. short smart message for card if we do one: "Happy birthday & congrats on 2 years, Sienna! Thanks for keeping onboarding sane :)"
rory: love that wording.
events-bot: Poll update: 9 votes 1 :bouquet:, 5 :cookie:, 3 :sparkles:
zara: bouquet + optional 30s video sounds good to me. i can collect 10 short clips from folks and stitch them on Saturday afternoon.
emma: ok sending Venmo link in DM aj. also will add GF note in the calendar invite if cookie wins.
aj: payment sent. if bouquet wins i'll post confirmation and ETA.
sienna: wow you all, this is so sweet. virtual bouquet + card + short video would mean a lot. thank you <3 :blush:
rory: final plan: bouquet + e-card + optional 30s compiled video. aj will procure bouquet, zara will edit video, emma will coordinate reception if needed. i'll post a calendar reminder and a card message thread.
events-bot: Reminder posted: "Sign the card for Sienna" in #people-ops. Deadline: 7/18 10:00am.
sienna: thank you everyone! no cake necessary, plants/cookies are fine but totally not needed. appreciate the warm wishes :heart:
